 Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Ujjal Bhuyan
 Order
Date : 08-04-2019
Heard Mr. SK Goswami, learned counsel for the petitioner.
On request, learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to make necessary correction in the cause title for addition of Sri Shankar Gupta as respondent No.6 by hand.

Matter relates to running of a sweet shop in the two storied RCC building belonging to Shri Bangshilal Gupta, father of the petitioner at UNC Road, Ward No.5, Dhubri, which building has been declared to be structurally unfit for running of commercial or any other activity by the office of the Deputy Commissioner, Dhubri as well as by the PWD Building Division.

In the inquiry conducted by the office of the Deputy Commissioner, Dhubri, it was found that the said sweet shop is being run by Sri Subhas Gupta in an unauthorized manner without obtaining any license under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Issue notice, returnable 6 weeks.

Ms. K Phukan, learned Government Advocate, Assam accepts notice on behalf of respondent Nos.1,
2 and 4.
Extra copies within 3 days.
Notice to respondent Nos.3, 5 and 6 by registered post with A/D.
Steps within 3 days.

On the next date, learned Government Advocate shall apprise the Court as to what follow-up steps have been taken by the Deputy Commissioner, Dhubri and Executive Officer, Dhubri Municipal Board after declaring the sweet shop of Sri Subhas Gupta and Sri Shankar Gupta as above to be unauthorized.
